lastAssistantText:
All checks clean: no browser-boundary leaks, no external refs, self-contained 18 KB single file, harness fully green.

## Summary

Delivered **`index.html`** — a single, self-contained, offline playable Snake game.

**Requirements met (13/13), all verified at runtime:**
- Playable grid Snake on a Canvas2D board (480×480, 20×20 cells)
- Keyboard controls: Arrow keys + WASD (bubbling `keydown` on document)
- Random food spawn on empty cells, snake grows + score increments when eaten
- Score, best (localStorage), and level HUD
- Wall collision and self collision → game over (head is the leading cell — I fixed an initial bug where the tail was treated as the head)
- Pause/resume (Space/P/buttons), restart (Enter/Restart button/Play)
- Increasing difficulty: tick interval decreases per level, clamped at a minimum
- Fully offline, single inline `<script>`/`<style>`, no CDN/network/link/image refs
- No Node/BOM-only globals (`require`/`process`/`module.exports`/`Buffer`/`global`) in browser code

**Verification:** `verify.cjs` drives the real code paths via the Skia Canvas2D VM runtime — pure-logic core (movement, collisions, food, level/speed maths, food spawn), DOM/runtime flow (HUD, overlays, canvas rendering, pixel check), and an integration lifecycle (start → draw → wall crash → game over → restart). All green, no console errors.

**One real bug found & fixed:** `createState()` built the snake tail-first, so "head" index 0 collided with itself instantly; corrected so index 0 is the leading cell.

**Environment-only caveats** (logged in `VERIFY.md`, not app bugs): no real keyboard/touch/WebGL (input verified via dispatched events), no real timer fidelity, and no browser-compositor visual-compatibility claim — canvas pixels are nonetheless read back and confirmed non-empty. No environment failures occurred.

Support files (`PLAN.md`, `VERIFY.md`, `verify.cjs`) hold the plan and verification evidence, as requested; the only deliverable is `index.html`.
